background: A modern patriotic song, a kind of letter home. Macedonian girl, sing and send greetings far away to brothers and sisters on three sides, from Ohrid to Pirin to Thessaloniki, separated for many years by borders.
background_source: Source of these notes: Qwen's draft.

lines.cyr: Поздрави браќа, сестри на три страни
lines.lat: Pozdravi braḱa, sestri na tri strani
lines.en: Send greetings to brothers, sisters to three sides

lines.cyr: од Охрид, до Пирин, дур' до Солуна.
lines.lat: od Ohrid, do Pirin, dur' do Soluna.
lines.en: from Ohrid to Pirin, on to Salonica.
brings tears to many broken hearts,
brothers and sisters, unseen for many years

lines.cyr: да се зберат браќа, сестри Македонци,
lines.lat: da se zberat braḱa, sestri Makedonci,

lines.cyr: сите ние да запејме, да се чуе
lines.lat: site nie da zapejme, da se čue

lines.cyr: од Охрид до Пирин, дур до Солуна.
lines.lat: od Ohrid do Pirin, dur do Soluna.
lines.en: from Ohrid to Pirin, on to Salonica.
